# Diagrams, presentations, video guides, and narration

This is the complete index of the finished results from the diagram and video experiments. Open HTML files in a browser; video players link to their downloadable MP4 files. Finished media is included in this repository. Raw production assets remain local. Skill and package repository links appear beside the collections that used them; local production scripts are in [tools/](tools/README.md).

Start with the [editorial architecture atlas](diagram-design/architecture.html), the [original technical architecture video](editorial-architecture-original/index.html), or the [parent and fencer guide with Qwen narration](parent-fencer-tutorial-qwen/index.html).

## Architecture videos

Skills: the two editorial editions use [Diagram Design](https://github.com/cathrynlavery/diagram-design) for their diagrams and style; the dark 3b1b edition uses [Answer Me with HTML](https://github.com/QingYunA/answer-me-with-html) and its bundled video renderer. The editorial editions use our [local presentation scripts](tools/README.md#architecture-presentations), [Playwright for Python](https://github.com/microsoft/playwright-python) for slide capture, and [FFmpeg](https://github.com/FFmpeg/FFmpeg) for video assembly. Their original speech uses the [ElevenLabs API](https://elevenlabs.io/docs/api-reference/text-to-speech/convert-with-timestamps), including the recovered narration in the pre-STE rebuild.

| Edition | Length | Watch | Video | Script | Captions |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Original pre-ASD-STE100 narration, editorial diagrams | 10:14 | [Chapter player](editorial-architecture-original/index.html) · [Presentation](editorial-architecture-original/presentation.html) | [MP4](editorial-architecture-original/architecture-video.mp4) | [Narration](editorial-architecture-original/narration.md) · [Original script](editorial-architecture-original/original-script.md) | [SRT](editorial-architecture-original/architecture-video.srt) |
| STE-inspired narration, editorial diagrams | 8:02 | [Chapter player](editorial-architecture-video/index.html) · [Presentation](editorial-architecture-video/presentation.html) | [MP4](editorial-architecture-video/architecture-video.mp4) | [Narration](editorial-architecture-video/narration.md) | [SRT](editorial-architecture-video/architecture-video.srt) |
| STE-inspired narration, dark 3b1b presentation | 9:08 | [Narrated presentation](architecture-video/architecture-video.html) | [MP4](architecture-video/architecture-video.mp4) | [Narration](architecture-video/narration.md) · [Authoring source](architecture-video/architecture-video.md) | [SRT](architecture-video/architecture-video.srt) |

The original pre-STE dark video was previously overwritten. Its narration was recovered for the editorial edition above. These are historical explanations of the app at their recorded source revisions; current decisions are in `ARCHITECTURE.md` (original local source).

Production notes: [original editorial](editorial-architecture-original/README.md), [STE editorial](editorial-architecture-video/README.md), [dark presentation](architecture-video/README.md). Standalone narration: [original editorial WAV](editorial-architecture-original/narration.wav), [STE editorial WAV](editorial-architecture-video/narration.wav).

## Parent and fencer instruction videos

Style comes from [Diagram Design](https://github.com/cathrynlavery/diagram-design). These walkthroughs use our [local tutorial scripts](tools/README.md#parent-and-fencer-videos), Xcode Simulator recordings, [Playwright for Python](https://github.com/microsoft/playwright-python) for slide capture, and [FFmpeg](https://github.com/FFmpeg/FFmpeg) for timing, magnification, highlights, transitions, and export. The Qwen edition uses [MLX Audio](https://github.com/Blaizzy/mlx-audio) with [Qwen3-TTS](https://github.com/QwenLM/Qwen3-TTS) speech and the [Qwen3 ForcedAligner model](https://huggingface.co/mlx-community/Qwen3-ForcedAligner-0.6B-8bit) for transcript timing. The first and paced editions use the [ElevenLabs API](https://elevenlabs.io/docs/api-reference/text-to-speech/convert-with-timestamps).

| Edition | Length | Watch | Full video | Script | Captions |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Qwen Aiden voice; measured word highlighting, title cards, transitions, and pauses | 6:56 | [Chapter player](parent-fencer-tutorial-qwen/index.html) | [MP4](parent-fencer-tutorial-qwen/parent-fencer-guide.mp4) | [Narration](parent-fencer-tutorial-qwen/narration.md) | [SRT](parent-fencer-tutorial-qwen/captions.srt) |
| ElevenLabs voice; title cards, transitions, and slower pacing | 7:45 | [Chapter player](parent-fencer-tutorial-paced/index.html) | [MP4](parent-fencer-tutorial-paced/parent-fencer-guide.mp4) | [Narration](parent-fencer-tutorial-paced/narration.md) | [SRT](parent-fencer-tutorial-paced/captions.srt) |
| First ElevenLabs edition | 5:04 | [Chapter player](parent-fencer-tutorial/index.html) | [MP4](parent-fencer-tutorial/parent-fencer-guide.mp4) | [Narration](parent-fencer-tutorial/narration.md) | [SRT](parent-fencer-tutorial/captions.srt) |

Each edition also has seven standalone demonstrations. All use fictional names and demo media.

| 1. Add a fencer and a tournament | [MP4](parent-fencer-tutorial-qwen/lesson-01.mp4) | [MP4](parent-fencer-tutorial-paced/lesson-01.mp4) | [MP4](parent-fencer-tutorial/lesson-01.mp4) |
| 2. Add a schedule from a Photos screenshot | [MP4](parent-fencer-tutorial-qwen/lesson-02.mp4) | [MP4](parent-fencer-tutorial-paced/lesson-02.mp4) | [MP4](parent-fencer-tutorial/lesson-02.mp4) |
| 3. Add a bout manually | [MP4](parent-fencer-tutorial-qwen/lesson-03.mp4) | [MP4](parent-fencer-tutorial-paced/lesson-03.mp4) | [MP4](parent-fencer-tutorial/lesson-03.mp4) |
| 4. Import videos into a bout | [MP4](parent-fencer-tutorial-qwen/lesson-04.mp4) | [MP4](parent-fencer-tutorial-paced/lesson-04.mp4) | [MP4](parent-fencer-tutorial/lesson-04.mp4) |
| 5. Create review clips and understand favorites | [MP4](parent-fencer-tutorial-qwen/lesson-05.mp4) | [MP4](parent-fencer-tutorial-paced/lesson-05.mp4) | [MP4](parent-fencer-tutorial/lesson-05.mp4) |

Production notes: [Qwen](parent-fencer-tutorial-qwen/README.md), [paced ElevenLabs](parent-fencer-tutorial-paced/README.md), [first edition](parent-fencer-tutorial/README.md), [capture notes](parent-fencer-tutorial/PRODUCTION_NOTES.md). Standalone narration: [Qwen WAV](parent-fencer-tutorial-qwen/narration.wav), [paced WAV](parent-fencer-tutorial-paced/narration.wav), [first edition WAV](parent-fencer-tutorial/narration.wav), [spoken titles WAV](parent-fencer-tutorial-paced/title-narration.wav).

## Local Qwen narration experiments

Repositories: [Qwen3-TTS](https://github.com/QwenLM/Qwen3-TTS) provides the speech model; [MLX Audio](https://github.com/Blaizzy/mlx-audio) provides the local speech server and generation tools on [Apple MLX](https://github.com/ml-explore/mlx). Both voice experiments use the [0.6B CustomVoice 8-bit MLX model](https://huggingface.co/mlx-community/Qwen3-TTS-12Hz-0.6B-CustomVoice-8bit). See the [local speech tools](tools/README.md#local-qwen-speech) and [locked package versions](tools/local-qwen-narration/requirements-lock.txt) to reuse this setup.

Finished results stay in the named folders above. Python, JavaScript, the simulator capture harness, and dependency lists now live in `figures/tools/`. Reusable simulator recordings, demo inputs, fonts, backgrounds, and title images live in `figures/tools/assets/`. Temporary renders and logs belong in `.runtime/figures/`. The downloaded Qwen models and their Python environment live in `.runtime/qwen-tts/`.

The October 2026 cleanup removed render caches, intermediate frames, rehearsal logs, copied build projects, Python bytecode, and Finder metadata. It preserved finished videos, narration, diagrams, source captures, and downloaded models. Validation reports describe the original production checks; frame-comparison checks require rendering fresh intermediate frames first.
